PersonalTarget.description: connection_status=ready means server-verified OpenStack CLI connectivity. status=ready and deployable require fresh Kubernetes health, scoped deployment permission and dynamic application binding verification. Client reports or configuration alone cannot enable deployment.

PersonalReceiptInput.description: A receipt must match the active attempt_id. Legacy operations without an attempt accept legacy receipts until explicit resume issues an attempt. status=inspected requires the current unexpired reconciliation_id and inspection, with client_removed=false. Only identical final success receipt is acknowledged for 15 minutes after token revocation.

resumable.description: Read-only reconciliation verified a safe explicit preparation retry.
